title: Pre-registration: independent external validation of physics-informed augmentation for powder X-ray diffraction space-group classification
description:
Pre-registration of a journal extension of the IEEE ONCON 2026 paper “A Controlled Analysis of Physics-Informed Augmentation for Powder X-Ray Diffraction Classification” (ONCON26-000086). It fixes the hypotheses, the cohort rules, the models and the analysis before any opXRD or RRUFF pattern is downloaded, and records the SHA-256 of every locked code file and training input. Sole author: Kishan Paschapur.

The registered files are in preregistration/. Licence scope: CC BY 4.0 applies to the pre-registration files (preregistration/), the README and this metadata only. paper.pdf is the author's version of the IEEE ONCON 2026 paper, copyright IEEE, and cv.pdf is the author's CV; neither is licensed under CC BY.
